mechanism: Prednisone increases renal potassium wasting and sodium retention; bumetanide (loop diuretic) further enhances potassium depletion and can cause hypokalemia, hyponatremia, and metabolic alkalosis.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (particularly potassium) regularly; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing agent; assess for signs of hypokalemia including muscle weakness and cardiac arrhythmias.
